SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY File No. S. B. D. 912 Special Branch - Station,）
Date April 24, 1939.
Subject Anti-Comintern Axis - meeting of Shanghai Consuls-General.
Made by. D. S. Pitts. Forwarded by C. Gaspar
With reference to the contents of the attached
report dated April 17, 1939, it has been learned
that the meeting referred to took place at 7 p.m.
April 18, 1939 at No. 250 Huncjao Road, the
residence of Mr. E. BRAUER, the German Consul-
General in Shanghai.
Details of the decisions taken have not
been ascertained.
E.
（批：ok）
Ja. Pitts.
D. S.

File 8/4 REGISTRY

Special Branch Station,
Date April 17 1939

Subject. Anti-Comintern Axis - Proposed Meeting of Shanghai Consuls-
General to Discuss Defence Plans.

Made by. J. A. Pitts. Forwarded by. C. Crawford i/c

Information secured from a source that has
proved accurate in the past is to the effect that
a conference is scheduled to take place during the
afternoon of April 18 between the Consuls-General
for Germany, Italy and Japan for the purpose of
discussing measures to be adopted for the defence
of nationals of these powers in the event of war
commencing in Europe.

The venue of the meeting is unknown but in this
respect the Astor House, Broadway Mansions and
Japanese Consulate-General are said to have been
mentioned.

Efforts to secure confirmation of this report
have failed so far.

（印：SHAN. MB 17 APR. 1939 COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE）

J. A. Pitts.
D. C. (Special Branch).

日期：1939年4月17日

主题：反共产国际轴心国——驻上海总领事拟议召开会议讨论防御计划。

撰写人：J. A. Pitts。转呈人：C. Crawford（主管）

从以往证明可靠的消息来源获得的情报显示，德国、意大利和日本总领事定于4月18日下午举行会议，目的是讨论一旦欧洲爆发战争，为保护这些国家侨民而应采取的措施。

会议地点不详，但据称提及了礼查饭店（Astor House）、百老汇大厦（Broadway Mansions）和日本总领事馆。

迄今未能证实此报告。

（印：上海。1939年4月17日 总监办公室）

J. A. Pitts.
D. C.（特别分处）。
